steps.title: Analyze Build Error
steps.description: Identify the stray backticks in MainActivity.java triggering the compilation failure.

steps.title: Remove Invalid Characters
steps.description: Clean MainActivity.java by deleting illegal trailing backtick characters at the end of the file.

steps.title: Validate File Endings
steps.description: Check that MainActivity.java correctly ends with closing braces and has no trailing syntax anomalies.

steps.title: Verify Package Hierarchy
steps.description: Ensure com.ludoclassic.app namespace alignment across code, resources, and configurations.

steps.title: Verify Android Manifest
steps.description: Confirm launcher settings, orientations, and themes are set properly.

steps.title: Verify Layout Bindings
steps.description: Check layout definitions for elements accessed inside MainActivity (like dice dot Views).

steps.title: Verify Engine Integrity
steps.description: Ensure game loops, piece movement validation, and player turn systems are preserved.

steps.title: Verify Custom Board View
steps.description: Check board graphics coordinate drawings and token overlapping layout rules.

steps.title: Verify State Persistence
steps.description: Validate that match state saves and restores seamlessly via SharedPreferences.

steps.title: Building Ludo Classic
steps.description: Compile the project using Gradle tool chain and generate the debug APK.
